faq.q: What is the origin of Aatika?
faq.a: Aatika is associated with Arabic. عاتكة is a well-attested pre-Islamic and early Islamic female name. Its use is reported in the sīra tradition.
Yes — the underlying form عاتكة is Arabic.
Aatika can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Aatika, aatika, atika. Script forms are عاتكة, عاتکه, عاتکہ, आतिका.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
